sources.title: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain 2026: How to Visit, Weather, Map - China Highlights
sources.content:
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: Complete Information

Basic Details
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain (Yulong Snow Mountain) is located in Lijiang, Yunnan, China, at an elevation of 5,596 meters (18,360 feet). It's "the most southerly always-snowcapped mountain in the Northern Hemisphere" featuring thirteen peaks resembling a flying dragon. The Naxi people call it "Heavenly Mountain" and revere it as their protector deity.

Main Attractions

Glacier Park (2-4 hours): Visitors can reach 4,680 meters elevation where "stairs for you to climb to reach a viewpoint" exist. Snow abundance varies seasonally, with March having the most snow and July-August the least.

Blue Moon Valley (1 hour): A crescent-shaped valley where "the water is blue on sunny days, and the white mud at the bottom of the lake makes it look particularly moon-like."

Spruce Meadow (2-3 hours): A flat area surrounded by tall trees, ideal for peaceful forest experiences and mountain viewing.

Yak Meadow (2-3 hours): An alpine meadow with rolling hills and a river, featuring grazing yaks and boardwalk trails.

Ganhaizi Meadow (1-2 hours): Best for sunrise viewing with lake reflections of the snow-covered peaks.

Cable Car System

Three cableways operate: Glacier Park (10 minutes), Spruce Meadow (8 minutes), and Yak Meadow (20 minutes). "Queues for the cableway could last for up to 3 hours during the summer peak season." Cable cars may close "if it is too windy, which happens most often from December to February."

Operating Hours & Best Times

Operating hours: "6am to 6pm (May to October), 6:30am to 6pm (November to April)."

Optimal visiting periods:
- November to April: Best for snow scenery with abundant snowfall
- May, September, October: Good weather with fewer crowds
- June to August: Summer only shows peak snow; frequent rain and large crowds

Weather Considerations
Winter temperatures are cold early morning. Altitude sickness is a concern at higher elevations; "portable oxygen canisters and warm clothes are necessary to recover." Down jackets rent for approximately 50 CNY.

Transportation
From Lijiang Old Town, "a 1-hour journey by private vehicle, taxi, or shuttle bus would get you to the foot of the mountain."

Sunrise Tips
Best spots: Ganhaizi Meadow or Dongba Valley. Winter offers the clearest conditions. Typical sunrise times: "6am to 7am" (May-October) or "7:30am to 8am" (November-April).

sources.title: Step-by-Step Guide to Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Travel 2026
sources.content:
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain Travel Guide - Complete Information

Overview & Location
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is situated near Lijiang in Yunnan Province. "The highest peak is Shanzidou. It is 5,596 meters tall." The mountain holds spiritual significance for the Naxi people.

Main Attractions
- Glacier Park: High-altitude glacier views accessible via cable car
- Tiger Leaping Gorge: Deep canyon for hiking or driving
- Blue Moon Valley: Clear water lakes with cultural significance
- Spruce Meadow: Seasonal landscape changes
- Yak Meadow: Encounters with yaks and Tibetan temples

Entrance Fees (2026)
- Standard entrance: 120 RMB
- Students (50% discount with valid ID)
- Seniors 60-69 (50% off)
- Seniors 70+ (free)
- Children under 1.2m height (free)

Park Hours
- May 1 - Oct 31: 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Nov 1 - Apr 30: 6:30 AM to 6:00 PM

Cable Car Options
- Glacier Park: 10 minutes, elevation 4,506m
- Spruce Meadow: 8 minutes
- Yak Meadow: 20 minutes

Transportation from Lijiang
- Taxi: 40-60 minutes, negotiable rates
- Tourist buses: ~1 hour, economical
- Local buses: Cheapest but time-consuming

Hiking Trail: Main route spans 12.5 km requiring approximately 6 hours, moderate difficulty through elevations of 2,700-3,300 meters.

Key Travel Tips
Book tickets at least three days ahead, especially during peak seasons. Arrive early to avoid crowds. Stay hydrated at high altitude and move at a deliberate pace.

sources.title: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, Lijiang: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: Complete Information Extract

Location & Basic Facts
Jade Dragon Snow Mountain (Yulong Xueshan) is located northwest of Lijiang Old Town in Yunnan Province. The mountain features 13 peaks with the highest point, Shanzidou, reaching 5,596 meters (18,360 feet). It's considered a sacred site by the Naxi people and part of the UNESCO World Heritage Three Parallel Rivers Protected Areas.

Major Attractions

Glacier Park (Bingchuan Gongyuan): The primary destination where visitors ascend via the Big Ropeway from 3,356 to 4,506 meters, then continue on wooden boardwalks to 4,680 meters - "the highest that visitors typically reach." Cable car journey takes approximately 15 minutes.

Blue Moon Valley (Lanyue Gu): "This crescent-shaped valley offers some of the most stunning alpine scenery in all of China." Four distinct lakes created by glacial melt with distinctive turquoise coloring.

Spruce Meadow (Ganhaizi): Located at 3,240 meters, dense spruce forests hosting Naxi cultural performances.

Yak Meadow (Maoniuping): Accessible via the Middle Ropeway at 3,700 meters elevation, panoramic peak views.

Elevation & Climate Zones
Seven distinct climate zones from Subtropical (1,800-2,800m) to Nival (above 5,000m). Supports "more than 3,800 kinds of wild plants" and endangered species including Yunnan golden monkeys and snow leopards.

Ticket Pricing (2026)
- Base Entry Ticket: 100 RMB
- Glacier Park Cable Car + Shuttle: 140 RMB
- Yak Meadow Cable Car + Shuttle: 65 RMB
- Spruce Meadow Cable Car + Shuttle: 60 RMB
- Impression Lijiang Show (Regular): 280 RMB
- Impression Lijiang Show (VIP): 346 RMB

"Starting from January 21, 2025, tickets for the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain cableways will be available for pre-sale 7 days in advance."

Transportation from Lijiang
- Bus: Route 101 direct service costs 15 RMB, approximately 1-hour travel time
- Taxi: 80-120 RMB for round trip
- From Airport: 45 kilometers, taxi 120-150 RMB

Best Time to Visit
Optimal: October to April
- October-December: Fall colors with stable weather
- January-March: Maximum snow coverage and clear skies
- April: Spring emergence with wildflowers
- Avoid: June-August monsoon season

Practical Tips
- Arrive in Lijiang minimum one day before mountain visit
- Stay hydrated and avoid alcohol 24 hours prior
- Oxygen canisters available for 68-98 RMB
- Warm jacket essential (temperatures drop to -10C at elevation)
- Sunglasses and sunscreen for intense UV
- Camera extra batteries (cold drains power)

Crowding Patterns
"Peak crowding occurs during Chinese holidays (Golden Week in October, Spring Festival) and summer weekends. Weekday visits, especially Tuesday through Thursday, offer the most peaceful experience."

Cultural Significance
The Naxi people revere the mountain as the dwelling place of Sanduo, their protective deity. "According to ancient beliefs, Sanduo manifests as a young warrior dressed in white armor, riding a white horse, and carrying a white spear." Spruce Meadow is known as "the gateway to the mythical 'Yulong Third Country,' a utopia of eternal happiness."

sources.title: Visiting the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in Lijiang, China! 4506 Meters High! - Feastography
sources.content:
Visiting the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain in Lijiang, China! 4506 Meters High!

Author: James Kaewanan | Date: April 22, 2024

The author visited Yunnan province in April and highlights the Yulong Jade Dragon Snow Mountain near Lijiang as a trip highlight. The attraction draws "10,000 visitors every single DAY."

Mountain Range Details:
The Jade Dragon Snow Mountain comprises the larger Yulong Mountain Range. The highest peak, Shanzidou, reaches 5,596 meters. The "highest publicly available observation points is at 4,506 meters." An observation point exists at 4,680 meters - "the highest in the world" - though the author didn't reach it.

Low Oxygen Warning:
Oxygen levels on the mountain are low, causing "dizziness, rapid heart beats, breathing difficulties, and possibly even brain damage." Portable oxygen tanks cost "about 40 RMB" at local shops or "around 100 RMB" at hospitals. The author warns that local shops sell "fake questionable gas," recommending hospital purchases.

Transportation Methods:
From Lijiang City (20 km away):
- Tourist bus from South Gate, Lijiang Ancient Town: 40 RMB
- Public Bus Number 7 from Hong Tai Yang Square: 15 RMB
- Organized tours include tickets and Impression Lijiang show

Cable Car Experience:
Cable car cost: 180 RMB. Park entrance fee: additional 180 RMB. The ride ascends 4,000 meters. The author's mother described it as "feeling like ascending into heaven."

On-Mountain Experience:
Weather: Despite altitude, conditions feel surprisingly warm with only a cool breeze. The author was sweating, not cold.
Views: "The lights reflecting off the snowy mountains makes for an incredibly pure white picturesque view." From the 4,506-meter point, visitors can see Lijiang city.

Practical Details:
Opening Hours: 6:00 AM - 6:00 PM daily
Total cost: 360 RMB (entrance + cable car)

sources.title: How to Plan a Trip to Jade Dragon Snow Mountain - Top China Travel
sources.content:
How to Plan a Trip to Jade Dragon Snow Mountain

Hours of Operation: 6:00-18:00 (May 1st to Oct. 31st); 6:30-18:00 (Nov. 1st to Apr. 30). Ticketing stops at 16:00.

Tickets and Costs:
- Entrance ticket: 180 yuan
- Tourist bus ticket: 20 yuan
- Cable car to Glacier Park: 180 yuan
- Cable car to Spruce Meadow: 55 yuan
- Cable car to Yak Meadow: 60 yuan

Tickets sell out fast, with only 10,000 available daily. They're released around 8pm the night before and are usually gone by 8pm.

How to Book: Through the official Jade Dragon Snow Mountain website, Ctrip (Trip.com), Fliggy, or Meituan. Also via WeChat mini program by searching 丽江旅游集团.

Getting There: Bus route 101 operates from Zhongyi Market at the South Gate of Lijiang Old Town directly to the parking lot. Bus ticket is 15 yuan, journey takes approximately 1 hour.

Best Time to Visit: Autumn and winter, especially January, February and April, when the sky is clear and you can have a better view of the snow mountain.

sources.title: 玉龙雪山 - 百度百科
sources.content:
玉龙雪山：完整信息提取

基本信息
玉龙雪山为云南省丽江市境内雪山群。全长75千米，全山的13座山峰由南向北纵向排列，主峰扇子陡最高处海拔5590.2米，雪线高度介于4800-5000米之间。

文化与命名
"玉龙雪山在纳西语中被称为'欧鲁'，意为'天山'"。其13座雪峰连绵，宛若"巨龙"腾越飞舞，故称"玉龙"。因岩性主要为石灰岩与玄武岩，"黑白分明"，又称"黑白雪山"。系纳西人神山，传说纳西族保护神"三朵"的化身。

地质构造
处于青藏、云贵2个高原衔接部位，为横断山系云岭山脉主峰，属年轻石灰岩断块褶皱山。

冰川资源
"玉龙雪山是亚欧大陆最南端的现代季风海洋型冰川分布区"。分布19条现代冰川，东坡15条，西坡4条，总面积11.6平方千米。白水1号冰川规模最大，长2.7千米。

冰川变化
- 1982-2002年：白水1号冰川冰舌后退约250米
- 2001-2009年：由19条冰川缩减为13条，总面积由11.6平方千米减至4.42平方千米

气候特征
属南温带型高原季风气候区。年降水量935毫米，6-10月为雨季；年平均温度12.79°C；年日照时数平均2530小时。海拔每升高100米，平均气温递减0.86°C。

植被与动物
超过2815种种子植物。珍稀濒危保护物种96种。一级保护动物包括滇金丝猴、绿尾虹雉。

旅游开发
已开发景区主要有：冰川公园、甘海子、蓝月谷、云杉坪、牦牛坪。

甘海子：原为高山冰蚀湖泊，整个大草甸长约4公里，宽约1.5公里。
蓝月谷：玉龙雪山冰雪融化成河水从雪山东麓山谷而过。河水形成4个较大水面：玉液湖、镜潭湖、蓝月湖和听涛湖。
白水河：河床由白色大理石、石炭石碎块组成。
云杉坪：海拔3240米，纳西语称"吾鲁游翠阁"，意为殉情之地。在纳西族传说中为"玉龙第三国"。
牦牛坪：海拔3700米，纳西语称"阁展古"。

历史荣誉
- 1984年：省级自然保护区建立
- 1988年：国家重点风景名胜区
- 2007年5月：国家首批5A级旅游景区
- 2024年：入选首批世界旅游名山
